records.text: Turning Point USA appeared to have misestimated crowd size; the Akins Ford Arena was less than 25% filled for Vice President Vance.
records.speaker: Jake Traylor

appearances.snippet: And the accompanying video of the auditorium, he wrote, turning point USA seems to have misestimated crowd size for Vance, the Akins Ford Arena less than 25% filled for the vice president. Now he's assuming it's because of Vance, right, that people are not showing.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous footage and reporting identify Jake Traylor as posting that the arena was less than 25 percent filled. Reported attendance around 2,000 in a venue exceeding 8,000 seats is consistent with that estimate.

sources.title: JD Vance Humiliated by Embarrassing Crowd Size at Free Show
sources.relevance: Reproduces Traylor post and independently reports venue capacity and approximate attendance.
